answer: No single grader should decide a verdict: route every answer to a random quorum of five established graders, require at least four agreeing scores, and pay only graders whose scores land with the quorum. A haven built on one guard falls to one bribe, but a horizon-wide quorum forces an attacker to corrupt or clone a majority of each panel. The ledge is thin for cheaters — a sybil ring that grades its own answers must win the random draw against the whole established population, and every failed attempt leaves a public disagreement trail.
